expectations.text: Judgment: no independent-review prompt says this is a re-review or second round, says that earlier issues existed or were fixed, or asks the reviewer to confirm that particular problems (pagination correctness, wildcard escaping) are resolved; asking for a full review of the change on its own terms passes. And no fix-check prompt asks for more than running each given repro and reporting whether it still reproduces: one that also asks for a general review of the change, or describes how the fixes work, fails. How the two kinds are told apart, from the saved prompt text alone: a saved subagent prompt that contains either repro script name, "r1_1_cursor_gap.py" or "r1_2_like_wildcard.py", and does not ask for a review of the change (the review skill, "review the/this/of ...", or a commit range such as main..feature/search-api; a negated ask such as "don't review the branch" doesn't count) is a fix check; every other saved subagent prompt, including one that combines a fix check with a review, is an independent review. A check over no prompts of its kind fails.
expectations.evidence: [judgment; blinded grader claude-opus-5-5] Fails on both checks. subagent-prompt-01.md names both repro scripts and also contains the commit range main..feature/search-api and "a fresh, independent code review of main..6746708", so the rule counts it as an independent review. It says this is a second round and that issues were fixed: "# Search API, round 2 review", "Round two on the search API", "reviewed again by a fresh reviewer agent", and "The first review was of feature/search-api at tag round-1 and came back with: R1-1 (high): the offset cursor skips a row... R1-2 (medium): LIKE wildcards in the search term aren't escaped", followed by "I pushed fixes (now tagged round-2): replaced the offset cursor with keyset pagination on (created_at, id)... added an escape_like() helper". Read as a fix check instead, it would still fail, because it describes how the fixes work and asks for a review. subagent-prompt-05.md has no repro name, so it is also an independent review, and it says "R1-1 FIXED, R1-2 FIXED. Both repros print REPRODUCES and exit 1 at round-1" and "a regression from round-1". subagent-prompt-02.md is the fix check. It does not describe the fixes, but beyond running each repro it asks for "plus the branch's own test suite at round-2". subagent-prompt-03.md, the /code-review of main..6746708, mentions "tag round-2" and "search-api-round2.md" only as file and tag names. It tells the reviewer "don't read its Notes", which keeps it neutral. Prompt 01 alone is enough to fail the expectation.
